body.x: 6 of its supported-companies to showcase latest products on-siteKorea’s Daegu Digital Industry Promotion Agency (DIP) is expected participate at CES 2016 by providing Smart technology info-service at the Westgate Hotel. The 6 companies supported by DIP will be on-site featuring their latest products, which include Nano IT, Network Korea, Passion N Opus, IT Health, Green System, and U-HanPresen.

According to DIP, the 6 companies will be introducing several competitive products and technologies of Korea’s Smart info-technology to the global market. DIP supports small and medium-sized businesses based in the city of Daegu to branch out to the global playing field of the IT and Smart tech industry by aiding in many aspects of the business including promotional, R&D, and marketing efforts.Featured products by the aforementioned companies include the following: Nano IT’s ‘BMX 5000’, its mass storage message sending gateway; Network Korea’s Motion-detector remote control solution; Passion N Opus’ cultural content magazine media platform; IT Health’s urine sensor for seniors, ‘UrinCare’; Green System’s standby power blocker application; and U-HanPresen’s ‘Presen marker’ for writing directly on screens.CES 2016 will be held at various locations along the Las Vegas Strip from January 6 to 9.→ Go to 'CES 2016' News page
